story.titleZh: 挑战在无摩擦和风险中驾驭速度
story.summaryZh: 埃里克·恩斯特表示，#SecuringSpeed 意味着在不产生摩擦和风险的情况下驾驭速度，并探讨了人工智能在车队中的应用以及 Zscaler 的 #ZeroTrust 基础如何实现快速安全。

story.summaryEn:
"The challenge is to harness speed, without friction and risk. That's what #SecuringSpeed means to us, and to @Zscaler." Eric Ernst, Commercial Technology Ambassador
Discover how AI is making a difference across the team, and why Zscaler’s #ZeroTrust foundation enables security at speed.
detailZh:
“挑战在于如何驾驭速度，同时避免摩擦和风险。这就是对我们来说，#SecuringSpeed 的意义，以及对于 @Zscaler 来说是什么。” 艾瑞克·恩斯特，商业技术大使
了解人工智能如何在整个团队中发挥作用，以及为什么 Zscaler 的 #ZeroTrust 基础设施能够实现快速安全。
detailEn:
"The challenge is to harness speed, without friction and risk. That's what #SecuringSpeed means to us, and to @Zscaler." Eric Ernst, Commercial Technology Ambassador
Discover how AI is making a difference across the team, and why Zscaler’s #ZeroTrust foundation enables security at speed.
story.leadZh: 埃里克·恩斯特表示，#SecuringSpeed 意味着在不产生摩擦和风险的情况下驾驭速度，并探讨了人工智能在车队中的应用以及 Zscaler 的 #ZeroTrust 基础如何实现快速安全。
bodyZh: 埃里克·恩斯特表示，#SecuringSpeed 意味着在不产生摩擦和风险的情况下驾驭速度，并探讨了人工智能在车队中的应用以及 Zscaler 的 #ZeroTrust 基础如何实现快速安全。

Austin, we see you.
We know that there's more than one way to celebrate F1, and there's more than one side to Austin. That's why this #USGP, we're bringing I / AM to ATX to share in the race week rituals with local communities.
You. Us. Together.
Find out more: https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/news/feature/i-am-austin-for-the-new-generation-of-fans
detailZh:
奥斯汀，我们看到了你。
我们知道庆祝F1的方式不止一种，奥斯汀也有不止一面。这就是为什么在本届美国大奖赛，我们将I / AM带到ATX，与当地社区一起分享赛车周的仪式。
你。我们。一起。
了解更多信息：https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/news/feature/i-am-austin-for-the-new-generation-of-fans

relatedItems.summaryZh: Yasmeen是2025年aramco STEM挑战赛的三名获胜者之一。她在AMR技术中心的沉浸周活动中，通过亲身体验碳纤维制造和解决赛车燃油策略挑战，更接近了F1赛车背后的工程。

relatedItems.summaryEn:
Meet Yasmeen, one of three winners of the 2025 @aramco STEM Challenge.
From seeing carbon fibre manufacturing first-hand to tackling a race fuel strategy challenge, Yasmeen’s Immersion Week at the AMR Technology Campus brought her closer to the engineering behind an F1 car.
detailZh:
遇见Yasmeen，她是2025年aramco STEM挑战赛的三位获胜者之一。

detailEn:
Meet Yasmeen, one of three winners of the 2025 @aramco STEM Challenge.
From seeing carbon fibre manufacturing first-hand to tackling a race fuel strategy challenge, Yasmeen’s Immersion Week at the AMR Technology Campus brought her closer to the engineering behind an F1 car.
